description: How to begin bringing a project over from Jira — this tool does not begin it. An import from a Jira site needs the site's API token, and a token is never given through a chat: the answer is the link to the Import tab, where the person types it; the plan is then readable here with get_import. A Jira Server nobody outside can reach goes as a file: the tab's tool reads one project into a .zip inside that network, and the local pm-files server's upload_import_archive sends it from this machine by its path, part by part — never as base64 in a parameter. The company's administrator only.
name: new_import
title: New import
